headline: Ebola is spreading faster in eastern Congo than it can be tracked, as deaths pass 700
context: Eighty percent of new Ebola cases in eastern Congo are emerging from unknown chains of transmission, according to WHO, a sign the outbreak is spreading faster than health officials can track.
